_comment: Illustrative parameters for a GalNAc-like siRNA. They are NOT fitted to any
real compound and no proprietary data was used. They are chosen to put each
process on a plausible timescale and to reproduce the 36.7 % protein nadir
EC50 is calibrated (see run_all.py --calibrate) so that the reference
simulation hits that nadir; every other value is set by hand.

provenance.k_el, k_up: plasma half-life ~1.3 h; 80 % of dose partitions to tissue
provenance.k_esc, k_degt: tissue pole 0.74 d; 10 % escape fraction (degradation wins)
provenance.k_loss: RISC-loaded pool decays with a 50 d time constant
provenance.k_out, k_syn: target protein turnover 2.9 d; k_syn set so baseline = 1
provenance.EC50: calibrated to a 36.7 % nadir at the reference dose
